entries.title: The Last Bit
entries.summary: How machines compute exp and sin, and what two disagreeing Excels showed.
entries.note: This page renders the July 2026 PDF. It differs from the PDF in three places. The PDF says both machines ran the same Excel build; the measurement records name build 18429 on the Intel machine and build 20131 on the AMD machine, so CPU, build and operating system all changed together. The agreement footnote is reworded to the Handbook's claim rules, and two last-bit phrases are softened.
